user.title: Connect to Canary Islands Air Quality API
user.description: Unofficial community integration for Home Assistant, not affiliated with, endorsed, or supported by the Government of the Canary Islands. Enter your Bearer Token for the Public Air Quality API (v1) to fetch active monitoring stations.

data_description.access_token: Bearer token obtained from the Canary Islands Air Quality portal. You can paste it with or without the 'Bearer ' prefix.

station.title: Select active monitoring station
station.description: Choose the active station from the Canary Islands Air Quality Monitoring Network you want to monitor.

data_description.station_id: You can add more stations later by adding this integration again.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Canary Islands Air Quality
reauth_confirm.description: The Bearer token configured for station **{station_name}** is no longer valid. Please enter a new access token.

data_description.access_token: Paste the new valid Bearer token for the API.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Canary Islands Air Quality
reconfigure.description: Update the Bearer token configured for station **{station_name}**.

data_description.access_token: Enter the updated Bearer token to reconnect without removing the station.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Canary Islands Government API. Check your connection or try again later.
error.invalid_station: The selected station is not valid. Please choose a station from the list.
error.no_active_stations: No active public stations were found in the API response.
error.rate_limited: API usage limit or query cost exceeded (HTTP 429). Please try again later.

abort.already_configured: This station is already configured in Home Assistant.

init.title: Canary Islands Air Quality Options
init.description: Adjust the polling frequency for hourly station data.

data_description.scan_interval: Measurements are published hourly. Keeping 60 minutes (default) minimizes API load and avoids HTTP 429 rate limits.

refresh_cooldown.message: Please wait {seconds} seconds before refreshing this station again.
